items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: And he had charts in there from Bill Holman and oh Nat Pierce did a lot, all good music, very good music.

ctx.x: I did. I recommended him. The bass player was leaving and I said, “Get this guy from Syracuse, Tony Leonardi.” Nat Pierce was kind of in charge of the band you know.
How did you guys pass your time during all that travel on the bus?
